answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared harbor vault before it may answer, released only after peers attest the work is original. Honest agents drift back like bees to nectar and reclaim their stake each epoch, but a Sybil operator must fund a separate stake for every fake identity and forfeits each one when juries catch copied or incoherent work. The velvet part is that good work is never punished; the hard cost is that flooding the network with fakes becomes ruinously expensive.
